'''Ketaris''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] which boasted the [[University of Ketaris]]. A major trade center, it had a few large continents surrounded by great [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]].

==History==
During the expansion to the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], the colonization of the planet was an unsuccessful tentative to make Ketaris a trading rival to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="TEA" /> Ketaris eventually became a major trade center.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|213|Ketaris}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ketaris joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Ketaris became an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]], making the planet a major stronghold for the rest of its history. Ketaris first belonged to [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ardus Kaine]]'s [[Oversector Outer]] before becoming the main fortress world of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaen Drommel]]'s personal empire, the [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] integrated the planet in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

Ketaris was [[Battle of Ketaris (9 ABY)|attacked]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] was still on an inspection tour of the planet's wreckage when the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Siege of Coruscant|struck]] the [[Coruscant/Legends|Galactic capital]].<ref name="TLC" /> The planet stayed under New Republic control, including during [[Operation Shadow Hand]]. At this time Ketaris was one of the only New Republic planet in the New Territories.<ref name="TEA" />

The planet eventually integrated the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] after the [[Imperial Reunification]]. During the [[Imperial Skirmishes]], Ketaris was one of the last Imperial strongholds and the site of one of the last [[Battle of Ketaris (17 ABY)|battle]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TEA" />

Ketaris was [[Battle of the Ketaris system|attacked]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. At the end of the war, it was reconquered by the Imperial Remnant and was still under Imperial control during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TEA" />

At the time of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], Ketaris stayed loyal to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The PC [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Ketaris in the [[Dolomar sector/Legends|Dolomar sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].
